title: Shipping containers used for site storage and Building Code scope (Council Order 2021-01)

facts.text: The issue was whether shipping containers on the site, as used, were buildings under NBC(AE) 2019 and needed a building permit.
The appellant described the containers as storage boxes used for their intended storage purpose; the respondent raised ventilation and spatial-separation requirements.
The respondent stated that no formal alternative solution had been sought; it said submitted U.S. Coast Guard and fire-investigation reports did not address spatial separation or airtightness.

limitations: The case expressly says a formal alternative solution had not been sought.
The underlying reports are named in the appeal record but not attached as separate files.
